parent_name.value: Majority-owned by UFG Holdings Group, LLC; 'United Franchise Group' is an affiliated collection of brands, not a parent entity (FDD Item 1, pp.8-9)

formed.value: 2021-03-17 (Delaware limited liability company; began offering franchises 2021)

business_description.value: Hand-crafted charcuterie boards, boxes, catering and grab-and-go arrangements under the Graze Craze system.

marketing_fund.value: 2% of gross revenues to marketing fund; franchisor may increase to 4% (FDD Item 6, p.20)

territory.value: Protected physical-store territory; delivery areas may overlap or change; the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory (FDD Item 12, p.46)

term.value: 35 years + one additional 35-year successor term (FDD Item 17)

item20.value: 89 franchised + 1 company-owned = 90 outlets as of FY2025 (FDD Item 20, p.59)

litigation.value: No actions against Graze Craze Franchising, LLC itself; 4 disclosed matters involving United Franchise Group-family affiliates: Indiana Secretary of State Securities Division 24-0003 AC re Mac & Cheese (filed 2024-01-26); Molyneaux et al. v. Mac and Cheese Franchise Operations, LLC, Palm Beach County FL (filed 2024-12-16); FTC v. Minuteman Press / Speedy Sign-A-Rama (E.D.N.Y.); California DFPI v. Great Greek Franchising (Aug 2021) (FDD Item 3, p.7)

fee_veteran.value: $39,600 for eligible veterans (20% off the $49,500 initial franchise fee, first franchise location; FDD Item 5, p.9)

local_marketing.value: 5% of gross revenues on local marketing (FDD Item 6, p.20)
